title: Pin distributionSha256Sum in android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties
why: The wrapper properties file has no distributionSha256Sum key. Without it, gradlew's bootstrap download of the Gradle distribution has no integrity check beyond TLS — a compromised mirror/CDN or a MITM on a misconfigured proxy could substitute a malicious Gradle distribution that every subsequent local build and CI run would silently execute.
recommendation: Run `./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version 8.14 --distribution-type all` (or add distributionSha256Sum manually from Gradle's published checksums page) so the wrapper verifies the download and fails closed on mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: gradle-wrapper.properties contains a distributionSha256Sum line matching the official checksum for gradle-8.14-all.zip.
A deliberately-wrong checksum causes ./gradlew to fail the download instead of proceeding.
